gloss: hidden scoring cuts (made in food before cooking)

definitions.gloss: hidden knife cuts; scoring made on the underside of an ingredient
definitions.explanation: Shallow cuts made where they will not be seen on the finished dish, so that heat and seasoning penetrate faster and the piece is easier to eat. Standard practice with daikon, konnyaku, squid, and thick cuts of fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{隠|かく}し{包丁|ぼうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Score the underside of the daikon.

examples.japanese: {隠|かく}し{包丁|ぼうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧しみやすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Making hidden cuts helps the flavor soak in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裏側|うらがわ}→裏側：03042_uragawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{十字|じゅうじ}→十字：11919_juuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隠|かく}し{包丁|ぼうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧おく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{煮崩|にくず}れせず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: If you cut a cross on the underside beforehand, it cooks through without falling apart.

notes:
Literally "hidden knife." Here {包丁|ぼうちょう} stands for the cut made with the knife, not the knife itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隠|かく}し{包丁|ぼうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to make hidden cuts (the standard verb)
- ⟦{十字|じゅうじ}→十字：11919_juuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隠|かく}し{包丁|ぼうちょう}: a cross-shaped scoring cut
- ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{隠|かく}し{包丁|ぼうちょう}: cuts on the underside

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飾|かざ}り{包丁|ぼうちょう}→飾り包丁：30656_kazaribouchou⟧: decorative cuts — meant to be seen, for appearance
- ⟦{切|き}り{込|こ}み→切り込み：30657_kirikomi⟧: a slit, an incision — the general word for a cut into something
